name: Chorizo Breakfast Tacos
desc: Crumbled chorizo folded into soft scrambled eggs on crisp-edged corn tortillas with Jack cheese and salsa.

source.evidence: Searched chorizo breakfast tacos with eggs, milk, Monterey Jack and corn tortillas; a SparkPeople member recipe with the same list surfaced in search but could not be read, and America's Test Kitchen, Cuisine & Cocktails, and Lil' Luna versions all differ in ingredients.

ingredients.raw: 6 oz fresh Mexican chorizo, casings removed

steps: Crumble the chorizo into a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until evenly yellow.

Wipe out the skillet, coat with cooking spray, and set over medium heat. Add the eggs and stir slowly until they are mostly set but still a little wet, 2 to 3 minutes. Fold in the chorizo and cook until the eggs are set, about 1 minute more.
Heat a dry skillet over medium-high heat and warm the tortillas one or two at a time, about 45 seconds per side, until the edges crisp but they still bend. Keep them wrapped in a towel.
Sprinkle the cheese on the hot tortillas, top with the egg and chorizo, and finish with salsa and hot sauce.
tips: Use raw Mexican chorizo; cured Spanish chorizo is a firm sausage and will not crumble.

references.title: Texas Breakfast Tacos with Chorizo
